own_solution.law: Plane-wave intensity I = p_i^2/(2 Z1) with Z = rho c; normal-incidence pressure transmission coefficient t = 2 Z2/(Z1 + Z2); p_t = t p_i
assumptions: lossless uniform fluids, no return from below
continuity of pressure and normal velocity

notes: Z1 = 411.6 Pa s/m, Z2 = 1.479036e6 Pa s/m; p_i = sqrt(2*411.6*0.012) = 3.14299 Pa; t = 2/(1 + 2.7829e-4) = 1.99944; p_t = 6.2842 Pa. With I = 0.018 W/m^2, p scales by sqrt(1.5): 7.6966 Pa. Frequency appears in the wave (omega, k, particle displacement) but cancels from the pressure amplitude and the transmission coefficient for plane waves at normal incidence, so C. Second loudspeaker's sound does not reach the water: D. Earlier trial: D. Variants carry the same 0.006 W/m^2 and 640 Hz; TF89B and TBD48 are numeral-free.
